title: Cash Pickup Reactivation Fee: Personal Sender Account Tenure Discount
content:
**Training notes: tenure discount on the Cash Pickup reactivation fee.**

**What decides the discount?** The sender's Personal Sender Account whose status is active. Two things are read together: the account's level, and how long it has been open. Months open are the whole calendar months from the opening date to the day of the reactivation.

**What are the bands?**

| Personal Sender Account (active) | Discount taken off the reactivation fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| open at least 24 months, at level Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Premier or Paloma Private Client | 0.50 |
| open at least 12 months, at level Paloma Verified or Paloma Verified Plus | 0.25 |
| any other account | nothing |

**How is it taken off?** The discount is taken off the reactivation fee as a whole, meaning the tier's fee together with anything added to it. The fee never falls below zero, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

**Does a long-open Paloma Starter account qualify?** No. Neither band includes Paloma Starter, so any other account takes off nothing.

**Combinations (hypothetical accounts).**

| Level | Whole months open | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Private Client | 24 | 0.50 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 23 | nothing (under 24 months; the 12-month band covers Paloma Verified and Paloma Verified Plus only) |
| Paloma Verified | 12 | 0.25 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 11 | nothing |
| Paloma Starter | 48 | nothing |
